what: R2 on all twelve edges of a 40 x 30 x 20 box at once: every corner is a vertex where three equal rounds meet (a sphere octant)
method: the rounded box is the inner box (36 x 26 x 16) grown by the ball r = 2 (Minkowski sum, Steiner): V = abc + 2r(ab + bc + ca) + pi r^2 (a + b + c) + 4/3 pi r^3 = 23701.6872, A = 2(ab + bc + ca) + 2 pi r (a + b + c) + 4 pi r^2 = 4886.4424 with a, b, c the inner box's sides. Faces: 6 planes, 12 cylinders, 8 sphere corners = 26
